div.div:
حَرْمَى , applied to a female cloven-hoofed animal, (K,) or to a ewe, or she-goat, (S,) and to a she-wolf and to a bitch, (K,) Desiring the male: pl. حِرَامٌ and حَرَامَى, (S, K,) like عِجَالٌ and عَجَالَى, (S,) or the latter pl. is حُرَامَى; (so accord. to some copies of the K [like عُجَالَى];) as though its masc., if it had a masc., were حَرْمَانُ. (S.) ＝
-A2- حَرْمَى وَ ٱللّٰهِ means the same as أَمَا وَ ٱللّٰهِ [Verily, or now surely, by God]; (K;) as also حَزْمَى وَ ٱللّٰهِ. (K in art. حزم.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
